create_Siglip2Processor: create a Siglip2Processor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal image-text tasks
create_Siglip2ProcessorKwargs: create Siglip2ProcessorKwargs with text padding, truncation, max_length and image patch size settings
call_Siglip2Processor: call a Siglip2Processor instance to preprocess images and text inputs into model-ready tensors
load_Siglip2Processor: load a pretrained Siglip2Processor from a local directory or HuggingFace Hub model ID
save_Siglip2Processor: save a Siglip2Processor and its components to a local directory for reuse
